invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of records.collectAsList(), which is expected to return a non-null List.
The method returns records.collectAsList(), so result equals this value for all executions.
records.collectAsList() returns a List, so result must be an instance of List.
The result is exactly the list produced by records.collectAsList(), so the sizes must match.
If records.collectAsList() is empty, so is result, and vice versa.
